skill.displayName: Grok Imagine AI Image Generator – Create High-Resolution Images from Text with Aurora AI – API-powered
skill.summary: Grok Imagine image generator — create high-resolution images from text using xAI Aurora

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—connect with WeShop’s Grok Imagine to generate images from text using xAI Aurora.

- Supports high-resolution image generation from text prompts, with optional reference images.
- Integrates with WeShop OpenAPI; requires a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Provides descriptive endpoint documentation and security guidelines.
- Allows batch image creation (1–16 images per request).
- Includes polling for run status and clear instructions for retrieving results.
